y ≤ −x
Which of the following ordered pairs (x, y) is a solution to the system of inequalities above?
e: Нужно y ≤ x и y ≤ −x одновременно. Проверяем (0, −1): −1 ≤ 0 ✓ и −1 ≤ 0 ✓.

q: A local transit company sells a monthly pass for $95 that allows an unlimited number of trips of any length. Tickets for individual trips cost $1.50, $2.50, or $3.50, depending on the length of the trip. What is the minimum number of trips per month for which a monthly pass could cost less than purchasing individual tickets for trips?
e: Минимум поездок получится при самых дорогих билетах $3.50.
Ловушка: «could cost less» — берём самый выгодный для абонемента сценарий, то есть дорогие билеты.

q:
y ≤ x + 7
y ≥ −2x − 1
Which point (x, y) is a solution to the given system of inequalities in the xy-plane?
e: Desmos: вбейте оба неравенства и точки — только (14, 0) в двойной закраске.

q: A truck can haul a maximum weight of 5,630 pounds. During one trip, the truck will be used to haul a 190-pound piece of equipment as well as several crates. Some of these crates weigh 25 pounds each and the others weigh 62 pounds each. Which inequality represents the possible combinations of the number of 25-pound crates, x, and the number of 62-pound crates, y, the truck can haul during one trip if only the piece of equipment and the crates are being hauled?
e: Оборудование 190 фунтов уже занято: на ящики остаётся 5630 − 190 = 5440.
Ловушка: в C и D x и y перепутаны и не вычтено оборудование.

q: In the xy-plane, which of the following does NOT contain any points that are part of the solution set to 5x − 7y > 35?
c: The region where x > 0 and y > 0
The region where x < 0 and y < 0
The region where x < 0 and y > 0
e: При x < 0 и y > 0: 5x отрицательно, −7y отрицательно → 5x − 7y < 0, никогда не > 35.
Остальные области содержат решения: например, (8, 0) на оси x: 40 > 35; (10, 1): 43 > 35; (−1, −10): 65 > 35.

q: A salesperson's total earnings consist of a base salary of x dollars per year, plus commission earnings of 11% of the total sales the salesperson makes during the year. This year, the salesperson has a goal for the total earnings to be at least 3 times and at most 4 times the base salary. Which of the following inequalities represents all possible values of total sales s, in dollars, the salesperson can make this year in order to meet that goal?
e: Ловушка: базовая зарплата x уже входит в доход, поэтому комиссия должна дать от 2x до 3x, а не от 3x до 4x.

q: To complete a landscaping project, Adam charges a fee of $20.00 for his equipment and $9.50 per hour spent working on the project. To complete this same landscaping project, Caroline charges a fee of $17.00 for her equipment and $10.00 per hour spent working on the project. If x represents the number of hours spent working on the landscaping project, what are all the values of x for which Caroline's total charge is greater than Adam's total charge?
e: Desmos: две прямые 20 + 9.5x и 17 + 10x пересекаются при x = 6; правее Кэролайн дороже.

q: A number x is at most 2 less than 3 times the value of y. If the value of y is −4, what is the greatest possible value of x?
e: «At most 2 less than 3 times y» → x ≤ 3y − 2.

q:
y < −4x + 4
Which point (x, y) is a solution to the given inequality in the xy-plane?

A certain elephant weighs 200 pounds at birth and gains more than 2 but less than 3 pounds per day during its first year. Which of the following inequalities represents all possible weights w, in pounds, for the elephant 365 days after birth?
e: Ловушка: вариант C — забыли прибавить вес при рождении 200.

q: An event planner is planning a party. It costs the event planner a onetime fee of $35 to rent the venue and $10.25 per attendee. The event planner has a budget of $300. What is the greatest number of attendees possible without exceeding the budget?
e: Людей — целое число, берём наибольшее целое, не превышающее: 25.
Ловушка: округлять нужно вниз (26 человек уже превысят бюджет).

q:
H = 120p + 60
The Karvonen formula above shows the relationship between Alice's target heart rate H, in beats per minute (bpm), and the intensity level p of different activities. When p = 0, Alice has a resting heart rate. When p = 1, Alice has her maximum heart rate. It is recommended that p be between 0.5 and 0.85 for Alice when she trains. Which of the following inequalities describes Alice's target training heart rate?
e: Ловушка: 60 — это H при p = 0 (покой), не входит в тренировочный диапазон.

q: A small business owner budgets $2,200 to purchase candles. The owner must purchase a minimum of 200 candles to maintain the discounted pricing. If the owner pays $4.90 per candle to purchase small candles and $11.60 per candle to purchase large candles, what is the maximum number of large candles the owner can purchase to stay within the budget and maintain the discounted pricing?
e: Пусть L — большие, S — маленькие: S + L ≥ 200 и 4,9S + 11,6L ≤ 2200.
Чтобы больших было максимум, маленьких берём минимум: S = 200 − L.
Ловушка: нельзя взять только большие (2200/11,6 = 189) — тогда всего меньше 200 свечей.

q: A number x is at most 17 less than 5 times the value of y. If the value of y is 3, what is the greatest possible value of x?
e: «At most 17 less than 5 times y»: x ≤ 5y − 17.
Ловушка: «17 less than 5y» — это 5y − 17, а не 17 − 5y.

q: In the figure, AC = CD. The measure of angle EBC is 45°, and the measure of angle ACD is 104°. What is the value of x?
e: Треугольник ACD равнобедренный, а x — внешний угол треугольника DBE.
Внешний угол при E = сумма двух дальних углов: ∠D + ∠DBE = 38 + 45 = 83.
Ловушка: ∠BAE ≠ ∠CAD — лучи AB и AC разные, поэтому через треугольник ABE не решить.

q: In the figure shown, points Q, R, S, and T lie on line segment PV, and line segment RU intersects line segment SX at point W. The measure of ∠SQX is 48°, the measure of ∠SXQ is 86°, the measure of ∠SWU is 85°, and the measure of ∠VTU is 162°. What is the measure, in degrees, of ∠TUR?
e: Идём по цепочке треугольников к треугольнику RTU.

q: In the figure, AE intersects DB at point C and AB is parallel to DE, creating triangles ABC and CDE. If x = 63 and y = 2x − 47, what is the value of z?
e: Находим ∠B в △ABC, а z = ∠B как накрест лежащие при параллельных AB ∥ DE.

q:
Intersecting lines r, s, and t are shown below.
What is the value of x?
e: Находим углы треугольника между тремя прямыми.
Угол при s∩t внутри треугольника: 180 − 106 = 74°. При r∩t: 23°.
Третий угол треугольника: 180 − 74 − 23 = 83°. x — смежный с ним: 180 − 83 = 97.
Ловушка: x стоит снаружи треугольника — не отвечай 83.

q: The sum of the measures of two angles in a triangle is 64°. What is the measure of the third angle?
In the figure shown, line k intersects lines r and s. If w = 147, which additional piece of information is sufficient to prove that lines r and s are parallel?
e: Прямые параллельны, если соответственные углы равны (или односторонние дают 180).
w и y — соответственные углы (оба справа от прямых, выше секущей) → y = 147 доказывает параллельность.
Ловушка: x = 33 и y + z = 180 верны всегда (смежные углы) и ничего не доказывают.

q: In the figure above, MQ and NR intersect at point P, NP = QP, and MP = PR. What is the measure, in degrees, of ∠QMR? (Disregard the degree symbol when gridding your answer.)
e: Треугольник MPR равнобедренный, угол при вершине P — смежный с 60°.
∠QMR — это тот же угол ∠PMR, т.к. P лежит на MQ.
Ловушка: 70° при Q для ответа не нужен — он отвлекает.

q: In the figure, line q is parallel to line r, and both lines are intersected by line s. If y = 2x + 8, what is the value of x?
e: При параллельных прямых угол y и угол 58° — односторонние (sum 180) → y = 122.
Ловушка: проверь по рисунку, что y не соответственный к 58° — он лежит с другой стороны секущей.

q: In the figure above, AF, BE, and CD are parallel. Points B and E lie on AC and FD, respectively. If AB = 9, BC = 18.5, and FE = 8.5, what is the length of ED, to the nearest tenth?
e: Параллельные прямые делят стороны пропорционально: AB/BC = FE/ED.

q: In triangle ABC, the measure of angle A is 52° and AC = 30. In triangle PQR, the measure of angle P is 52° and PR = 120. Which additional piece of information is sufficient to prove that triangle ABC is similar to triangle PQR?
c: The measures of angle B and angle R are 32° and 96°, respectively.
The measures of angle B and angle Q are 52° and 32°, respectively.
e: Подобие по двум углам (AA): достаточно показать два равных угла.
D даёт углы 52-52-76 и 52-32-96 — не подобны. A и B не дают пропорции всех нужных сторон.

q: In triangle ABC, the measure of angle B is 90° and BD is an altitude of the triangle. The length of AB is 15 and the length of AC is 23 greater than the length of AB. What is the value of BC/BD?
e: Высота из прямого угла создаёт подобные треугольники: △CBD ~ △CAB.
Ловушка: ответ не требует находить BC и BD по отдельности.

q: Two nearby trees are perpendicular to the ground, which is flat. One of these trees is 10 feet tall and has a shadow that is 5 feet long. At the same time, the shadow of the other tree is 2 feet long. How tall, in feet, is the other tree?
△QPR is similar to △STR. The lengths represented by ST, QP, PR, and QR in the figure are 14, 15, 20, and 25, respectively. What is the length of SR?
e: Соответствие вершин: Q→S, P→T, R→R. Значит QP/ST = QR/SR.
Ловушка: следи за порядком букв в «△QPR ~ △STR».

q: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle XYZ, where A, B, and C correspond to X, Y, and Z, respectively. In triangle ABC, the length of AB is 170 and the length of BC is 850. In triangle XYZ, the length of YZ is 60. What is the length of XY?
In the figure, RT = TU, the measure of angle VST is 29°, and the measure of angle RVS is 41°. What is the value of x?
e: ∠RVS — внешний угол треугольника SUV: он равен сумме двух дальних углов.

q: In the figure shown, WZ and XY intersect at point Q. YQ = 63, WQ = 70, WX = 60, and XQ = 120. What is the length of YZ?
e: △WXQ ~ △YZQ: углы при W и Y равны (a°), углы при Q вертикальные.
Соответствие W→Y, X→Z, Q→Q: WX/YZ = WQ/YQ.

q: In triangles ABC and DEF, angles B and E each have measure 27° and angles C and F each have measure 41°. Which additional piece of information is sufficient to determine whether triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF?
c: The lengths of sides BC and EF
e: Равные углы дают только подобие; для congruence нужна пара соответствующих сторон.
BC и EF — соответствующие стороны (между углами 27° и 41°) → если равны, треугольники равны по ASA.
Ловушка: длина одной стороны AB без пары из второго треугольника ничего не даёт.

q: In triangles LMN and RST, angles L and R each have measure 60°, LN = 10, and RT = 30. Which additional piece of information is sufficient to prove that triangle LMN is similar to triangle RST?
c: The measures of angles M and S are 70° and 60°, respectively.
The measures of angles M and T are 70° and 50°, respectively.
e: C даёт 60-70-50 и 60-60-60 — нет. A и B: стороны MN и ST не лежат при известном углу, SAS не получается.

q: Each side of equilateral triangle S is multiplied by a scale factor of k to create equilateral triangle T. The length of each side of triangle T is greater than the length of each side of triangle S. Which of the following could be the value of k?
Triangles ABC and DEF are shown above. Which of the following is equal to the ratio BC/AB?
e: BC/AB = sin A = sin 32°. В △DEF угол 32° — при E (90 − 58).

q:
v = −w/(150x)
The given equation relates the distinct positive numbers v, w, and x. Which equation correctly expresses w in terms of v and x?
A system of equations consists of a quadratic equation and a linear equation. The equations in this system are graphed in the xy-plane above. How many solutions does this system have?
e: Решения — точки пересечения графиков. Прямая пересекает параболу в двух точках.

q:
y = x + 1
y = x² + x
If (x, y) is a solution to the system of equations above, which of the following could be the value of x?
e: Приравняем: x + 1 = x² + x → x² = 1 → x = ±1.
Desmos: пересечения прямой и параболы в x = −1 и x = 1.

q:
x² − x − 1 = 0
What values satisfy the equation above?

2|4 − x| + 3|4 − x| = 25
What is the positive solution to the given equation?

x² − 2x − 9 = 0
One solution to the given equation can be written as 1 + √k, where k is a constant. What is the value of k?
e: Ловушка: √40/2 = √10, а не √20 — вноси 2 под корень как 4.

q: In the xy-plane, a line with equation 2y = 4.5 intersects a parabola at exactly one point. If the parabola has equation y = −4x² + bx, where b is a positive constant, what is the value of b?
e: Прямая y = 2,25. Ровно одна общая точка — касание: −4x² + bx = 2,25 → 4x² − bx + 2,25 = 0 имеет один корень.
Ловушка: быстрее — вершина параболы на высоте b²/16 должна равняться 2,25 → b² = 36.

q:
x − y = 1
x + y = x² − 3
Which ordered pair is a solution to the system of equations above?
e: x = y + 1. Подставим: 2y + 1 = (y + 1)² − 3 = y² + 2y − 2 → y² = 3 → y = ±√3.
Ловушка: быстрее проверить вариант A в первом уравнении: (1 + √3) − √3 = 1 ✓.

q:
x² − 12x + 27 = 0
How many distinct real solutions does the given equation have?

r² + qr = 2r − 55
In the given equation, q is an integer constant. The given equation has no real solutions. What is the largest possible value of q?
e: Ловушка: сначала перенеси 2r влево: коэффициент при r равен q − 2, а не q.

q:
1/(x² + 10x + 25) = 4
If x is a solution to the given equation, which of the following is a possible value of x + 5?
e: Ловушка: заметь полный квадрат, не решай уравнение напрямую.

q:
√(k − x) = 58 − x
In the given equation, k is a constant. The equation has exactly one real solution. What is the minimum possible value of 4k?
e: Возведём в квадрат: k − x = x² − 116x + 3364 → x² − 115x + (3364 − k) = 0.
Ровно одно решение при нулевом дискриминанте: 115² − 4(3364 − k) = 4k − 231 = 0 → 4k = 231.
Ловушка: при больших k одно из двух решений может оказаться посторонним, но минимальное 4k даёт именно касание.
Desmos: вбей y = √(57.75 − x) и y = 58 − x — графики касаются.

q: During a 5-second time interval, the average acceleration a, in meters per second squared, of an object with an initial velocity of 12 meters per second is defined by the equation a = (v_f − 12)/5, where v_f is the final velocity of the object in meters per second. If the equation is rewritten in the form v_f = xa + y, where x and y are constants, what is the value of x?
e: Нужно выразить v_f через a: избавляемся от дроби.
Сравниваем с v_f = xa + y: x = 5, y = 12.
Ловушка: вопрос про x (коэффициент при a), а не про y = 12.

q:
2x² − 8x − 7 = 0

One solution to the given equation can be written as (8 − √k)/4, where k is a constant. What is the value of k?
e: Под корнем: 64 + 56 = 120. Знаменатель 4 — совпадает с формой (8 − √k)/4.
Ловушка: k — это discriminant b² − 4ac, не упрощайте √120 = 2√30 (форма задана с /4).

q:
7m = 5(n + p)

The given equation relates the positive numbers m, n, and p. Which equation correctly gives n in terms of m and p?
e: Делим обе части на 5: n + p = 7m/5.
Ловушка: сначала делим на 5 всю скобку, потом убираем p.

q:
2x² − 2 = 2x + 3

Which of the following is a solution to the equation above?
e: Ловушка: C выглядит похоже, но там на 2 делится только единица — не то.
Desmos: y = 2x² − 2 и y = 2x + 3; пересечение при x ≈ 2.16 = (1 + √11)/2.

q:
x² = −841

How many distinct real solutions does the given equation have?
e: Квадрат действительного числа не бывает отрицательным: x² ≥ 0.
Поэтому x² = −841 действительных решений не имеет.
Ловушка: не путайте с x² = 841 (два решения ±29).

q: In the xy-plane, a line with equation 2y = c for some constant c intersects a parabola at exactly one point. If the parabola has equation y = −2x² + 9x, what is the value of c?
e: 2y = c — горизонтальная прямая y = c/2. Она касается параболы ровно в одной точке — в вершине.
Ловушка: c — это 2y, а не y-координата вершины (81/8).

q:
(d − 30)(d + 30) − 7 = −7

What is a solution to the given equation?
e: Произведение равно нулю → d = 30 или d = −30.
Ловушка: не раскрывайте скобки — difference of squares уже разложена.

q:
(x − 47)² = 1

What is the sum of the solutions to the given equation?
e: Ловушка: не забывайте отрицательный корень — иначе получится одно решение.

q: A rectangle has a length that is 15 times its width. The function y = (15w)(w) represents this situation, where y is the area, in square feet, of the rectangle and y > 0. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 15w in this context?
c: The length of the rectangle, in feet
The area of the rectangle, in square feet
The difference between the length and the width of the rectangle, in feet
The width of the rectangle, in feet
e: Площадь = длина × ширина. w — ширина, 15w — длина (в 15 раз больше).

q:
f(x) = 27(1.20)^(x/3)
For the given function f, the value of f(x) increases by p% for every increase of x by 6. What is the value of p?
e: При увеличении x на 6 показатель x/3 растёт на 2: множитель 1,20² = 1,44.
Ловушка: не 20% и не 40% — множители перемножаются: 1,2·1,2 = 1,44.

q:
y = 9(a/7)^(x+c) − b
How many times does the graph of the given equation in the xy-plane cross the x-axis, where a, b, and c are positive constants such that a > 7 and b > c?
e: a/7 > 1 — возрастающая экспонента. Она принимает все значения от 0 до +∞, значит 9(a/7)^(x+c) − b — все значения от −b до +∞.
Так как b > 0, график проходит через 0 ровно один раз (горизонтальная асимптота y = −b ниже оси x).
Ловушка: экспонента монотонна — больше одного пересечения с осью x быть не может.
Desmos: вбей y = 9(2)^(x+1) − 3 — одно пересечение с осью x.

q: The product of two positive integers is 462. If the first integer is 5 greater than twice the second integer, what is the smaller of the two integers?
e: Ловушка: спрашивают меньшее число, а не 33.
Desmos: вбей x(2x + 5) = 462, положительный корень x = 14.

q: The function g is defined by g(x) = |x|/a − 14, where a < 0. What is the product of g(15a) and g(7a)?
e: Ловушка: модуль отрицательного числа меняет знак: |15a| = −15a, поэтому 15 → −15.

q:
y = 7,400(0.87)^x
The given equation estimates the value, in dollars, of a certain piece of equipment x years after it was purchased. According to the given equation, what was the estimated value, in dollars, of the piece of equipment at the time it was purchased?

x | g(x)
−27 | 3
−9 | 0
21 | 5
The table shows three values of x and their corresponding values of g(x), where g(x) = f(x)/(x + 3) and f is a linear function. What is the y-intercept of the graph of y = f(x) in the xy-plane?
e: f линейная через (−9, 0) и (21, 120): slope = 120/30 = 4, f(x) = 4(x + 9).
Ловушка: нужен y-intercept функции f, а не g.

q:
h(x) = 2(x − 4)² − 32
The quadratic function h is defined as shown. In the xy-plane, the graph of y = h(x) intersects the x-axis at the points (0, 0) and (t, 0), where t is a constant. What is the value of t?
e: Вершина в x = 4, парабола симметрична. Один корень 0, он на 4 левее вершины — второй на 4 правее: t = 8.
Ловушка: 4 — это ось симметрии, а не второй корень.

q:
f(x) = x² − 48x + 2,304
What is the minimum value of the given function?
e: Ловушка: спрашивают минимальное значение (y), а не x = 24.

q: The function f is defined by f(x) = (−8)(2)^x + 22. What is the y-intercept of the graph of y = f(x) in the xy-plane?
e: Ловушка: 22 — это горизонтальная асимптота (при x → −∞), а не y-intercept.

q: An auditorium has seats for 1,800 people. Tickets to attend a show at the auditorium currently cost $4.00. For each $1.00 increase to the ticket price, 100 fewer tickets will be sold. This situation can be modeled by the equation y = −100x² + 1,400x + 7,200, where x represents the increase in ticket price, in dollars, and y represents the revenue, in dollars, from ticket sales. If this equation is graphed in the xy-plane, at what value of x is the maximum of the graph?
e: Ловушка: 14 — это −b/a, забыли умножить a на 2.

q:
p(x) + 57 = x²
The given equation relates the value of x and its corresponding value of p(x) for the function p. What is the minimum value of the function p?
e: p(x) = x² − 57. Минимум x² равен 0 (при x = 0), значит минимум p = −57.

q:
f(x) = 9,000(0.66)^x
The given function f models the number of advertisements a company sent to its clients each year, where x represents the number of years since 1997, and 0 ≤ x ≤ 5. If y = f(x) is graphed in the xy-plane, which of the following is the best interpretation of the y-intercept of the graph in this context?
c: The minimum estimated number of advertisements the company sent to its clients during the 5 years was 1,708.
The minimum estimated number of advertisements the company sent to its clients during the 5 years was 9,000.
The estimated number of advertisements the company sent to its clients in 1997 was 1,708.
The estimated number of advertisements the company sent to its clients in 1997 was 9,000.
e: Ловушка: функция убывает, поэтому 9000 — максимум, а не минимум.

q: The first term of a sequence is 9. Each term after the first is 4 times the preceding term. If w represents the nth term of the sequence, which equation gives w in terms of n?
e: Геометрическая прогрессия: первый член 9, знаменатель 4. n-й член: 9·4ⁿ⁻¹.
Ловушка: вариант C даёт 36 при n = 1 — на один шаг больше.

q:
The function f is defined by f(x) = a(2.2^x + 2.2^b), where a and b are integer constants and 0 < a < b. The functions g and h are equivalent to function f, where k and m are constants. Which of the following equations displays the y-coordinate of the y-intercept of the graph of y = f(x) in the xy-plane as a constant or coefficient?
I. g(x) = a(2.2^x + k)
II. h(x) = a(2.2)^x + m
e: I: g(0) = a(1 + k) — ни a, ни k сами по себе не равны intercept. II: h(0) = a + m — тоже сумма, а не одна константа.
Ни одна форма не показывает intercept как отдельное число.
Ловушка: m = a·2.2^b — это не intercept, к нему ещё прибавляется a.

q: A physics class is planning an experiment about a toy rocket. The equation y = −16(x − 5.6)² + 502 gives the estimated height y, in feet, of the toy rocket x seconds after it is launched into the air. Which of the following is the best interpretation of the vertex of the graph of the equation in the xy-plane?
c: This toy rocket reaches an estimated maximum height of 502 feet 16 seconds after it is launched into the air.
This toy rocket reaches an estimated maximum height of 502 feet 5.6 seconds after it is launched into the air.
This toy rocket reaches an estimated maximum height of 16 feet 502 seconds after it is launched into the air.
This toy rocket reaches an estimated maximum height of 5.6 feet 502 seconds after it is launched into the air.
e: Vertex form: вершина (5,6; 502). x = 5,6 секунды, y = 502 фута — максимум (ветви вниз).

q:
Time (years) | Total amount (dollars)
0 | 604.00
1 | 606.42
2 | 608.84
Rosa opened a savings account at a bank. The table shows the exponential relationship between the time t, in years, since Rosa opened the account and the total amount n, in dollars, in the account. If Rosa made no additional deposits or withdrawals, which of the following equations best represents the relationship between t and n?
e: Начальная сумма 604. Множитель за год: 606,42/604 = 1,004 → рост 0,4%.

q:
x | g(x)
−1 | 25
0 | 1
1 | 1/25
2 | 1/625
For the exponential function g, the table shows four values of x and their corresponding values of g(x). Which equation defines g?
e: g(0) = 1 — коэффициент 1. Каждый шаг x на 1 делит значение на 25 → основание 1/25.
Ловушка: значения положительные — варианты с минусом не подходят.

q:
x | h(x)
0 | 1.23
2 | 1.54
4 | 1.94
The table shows the exponential relationship between the number of years, x, since Hana started training in pole vault, and the estimated height h(x), in meters, of her best pole vault for that year. Which of the following functions best represents this relationship, where x ≤ 4?
e: h(0) = 1,23 — начальное значение. Значения растут → основание больше 1.

q: Function f is defined by f(x) = −a^x + b, where a and b are constants. In the xy-plane, the graph of y = f(x) − 12 has a y-intercept at (0, −75/7). The product of a and b is 320/7. What is the value of a?
e: Ловушка: a⁰ = 1 при любом a, поэтому f(0) = −1 + b.

q: A sample of 40 fourth-grade students was selected at random from a certain school. The 40 students completed a survey about the morning announcements, and 32 thought the announcements were helpful. Which of the following is the largest population to which the results of the survey can be applied?
c: All fourth-grade students at the school
All fourth-grade students in the county in which the school is located
e: Результаты обобщаются только на ту группу, из которой случайно брали выборку.
Выборка — случайные четвероклассники этой школы → вывод про всех четвероклассников этой школы.
Ловушка: нельзя расширять на всю школу или округ — оттуда не выбирали.

q:
Residents of a town were surveyed to determine whether they are satisfied with the concession stand at the local park. A random sample of 200 residents was selected. All 200 responded, and 87% said they are satisfied. Based on this information, which of the following statements must be true?
I. Of all the town residents, 87% would say they are satisfied with the concession stand at the local park.
II. If another random sample of 200 residents were surveyed, 87% would say they are satisfied.
e: Выборка даёт только оценку, а не точное значение для всех жителей и не гарантию для другой выборки.
Ни I, ни II не обязаны быть верными.
Ловушка: слово «must» — утверждения про точные 87% никогда не гарантированы.

q: A survey was conducted using a sample of history professors selected at random from the California State Universities. The professors surveyed were asked to name the publishers of their current texts. What is the largest population to which the results of the survey can be generalized?
c: All professors in the United States
All history professors in the United States
All history professors at all California State Universities
All professors at all California State Universities
e: Обобщаем только на группу, из которой случайно выбирали: history professors из California State Universities.

q:
A trivia tournament organizer wanted to study the relationship between the number of points a team scores in a trivia round and the number of hours that a team practices each week. For the study, the organizer selected 55 teams at random from all trivia teams in a certain tournament. The table displays the information for the 40 teams in the sample that practiced for at least 3 hours per week.
Hours practiced | 6 to 13 points | 14 or more points | Total
3 to 5 hours | 6 | 4 | 10
More than 5 hours | 4 | 26 | 30
Total | 10 | 30 | 40
Which of the following is the largest population to which the results of the study can be generalized?
c: All trivia teams in the tournament that scored 14 or more points in the round
The 55 trivia teams in the sample
The 40 trivia teams in the sample that practiced for at least 3 hours per week
All trivia teams in the tournament
e: Обобщать можно на ту популяцию, из которой выборка взята случайно.
55 команд выбраны случайно из всех команд турнира → обобщаем на все команды турнира.
Ловушка: таблица только про 40 команд — это отвлечение; важно, откуда брали выборку.

q: A psychologist designed and conducted a study to determine whether playing a certain educational game increases middle school students' accuracy in adding fractions. For the study, the psychologist chose a random sample of 35 students from all of the students at one of the middle schools in a large city. The psychologist found that students who played the game showed significant improvement in accuracy when adding fractions. What is the largest group to which the results of the study can be generalized?
c: All middle school students in the city
e: Обобщаем на ту группу, из которой случайно отбирали.
Выборка — случайная из учеников одной школы → все ученики этой школы.
Ловушка: про всех школьников города сказать нельзя — из других школ никого не брали.

q:
A polling agency recently surveyed 1,000 adults who were selected at random from a large city and asked each of the adults, "Are you satisfied with the quality of air in the city?" Of those surveyed, 78 percent responded that they were satisfied with the quality of air in the city. Based on the results of the survey, which of the following statements must be true?
I. Of all adults in the city, 78 percent are satisfied with the quality of air in the city.
II. If another 1,000 adults selected at random from the city were surveyed, 78 percent of them would report they are satisfied with the quality of air in the city.
III. If 1,000 adults selected at random from a different city were surveyed, 78 percent of them would report they are satisfied with the quality of air in the city.
e: Выборка даёт оценку, а не точное значение, и только для своего города.
I — точного 78% для всех жителей гарантировать нельзя. II — другая выборка даст похожий, но не обязательно тот же процент. III — другой город вообще ни при чём.
Ни одно утверждение не обязано быть верным.
Ловушка: слово «must be true» — ищем, что гарантировано, а не что вероятно.

q:
A statistician conducted a study to investigate the relationship between the average number of minutes piano students practiced each week and the percentage of correct notes the students played during a recital. For the study, the statistician selected a sample of 85 piano students at random from all the piano students in a certain region who were in their second year with their conservatory. The table shows the information for 75 piano students in this sample who practiced at least 50 minutes on average each week.
Average number of minutes practiced each week | Less than 50% | 50% to 80% | Greater than 80% | Total
50 to 150 | 7 | 28 | 5 | 40
151 or more | 3 | 11 | 21 | 35
Total | 10 | 39 | 26 | 75
Which of the following is the largest population to which the results of the study can be generalized?
c: All piano students who were in their second year with their conservatory
All piano students in the region
All piano students in the region who were in their second year with their conservatory
The 75 piano students in the sample who practiced at least 50 minutes on average each week
e: Обобщаем ровно на ту группу, из которой случайно отбирали.
Выборка — из учеников региона на втором году обучения → и регион, и второй год обязательны.
Ловушка: A убирает «регион», B убирает «второй год» — обе слишком широкие.

q: Near the end of a US cable news show, the host invited viewers to respond to a poll on the show's website that asked, "Do you support the new federal policy discussed during the show?" At the end of the show, the host reported that 28% responded "Yes," and 70% responded "No." Which of the following best explains why the results are unlikely to represent the sentiments of the population of the United States?
c: The percentages do not add up to 100%, so any possible conclusions from the poll are invalid.
Those who responded to the poll were not a random sample of the population of the United States.
There were not 50% "Yes" responses and 50% "No" responses.
The show did not allow viewers enough time to respond to the poll.
e: Опрос добровольцев-зрителей одного шоу — не случайная выборка всей страны.
Ловушка: проценты не обязаны давать 100% (часть не ответила) — это не делает опрос недействительным.

q: To determine the mean number of children per household in a community, Tabitha surveyed 20 families at a playground. For the 20 families surveyed, the mean number of children per household was 2.4. Which of the following statements must be true?
c: The mean number of children per household in the community is 2.4.
A determination about the mean number of children per household in the community should not be made because the sample size is too small.
The sampling method is flawed and may produce a biased estimate of the mean number of children per household in the community.
The sampling method is not flawed and is likely to produce an unbiased estimate of the mean number of children per household in the community.
e: Опрос на детской площадке: туда приходят семьи с детьми → выборка смещена.
Проблема в методе отбора, а не в размере выборки.

q: For a baobab tree habitat in South Africa, a scientist randomly selected 50 baobab trees that were 17 years old and randomly assigned them to two groups. Each group was subjected to a different watering pattern for 2 consecutive years to observe whether the watering pattern affects the trees' growth rate. Based on the design of the study, what is the largest group to which these results can be applied?
c: All the 50 baobab trees that were selected in this habitat
All the baobab trees that were 19 years old in this habitat
All the baobab trees that were 17 years old in South Africa
All the baobab trees that were 17 years old in this habitat
e: Обобщаем на группу, из которой случайно отбирали: 17-летние баобабы этого habitat.
Ловушка: C расширяет на всю Южную Африку — выборка была только из одного habitat.

q:
4, 10, 18, 4, 4, 5, 6, 5
What is the median of the data set shown?
e: Сортируем: 4, 4, 4, 5, 5, 6, 10, 18. Восемь чисел → median = среднее двух средних.
Ловушка: сначала сортировка, иначе median посчитан неверно.

q: The box plots summarize the masses, in kilograms, of two groups of gazelles. Based on the box plots, which of the following statements must be true?
c: The mean mass of group 1 is greater than the mean mass of group 2.
The mean mass of group 1 is less than the mean mass of group 2.
The median mass of group 1 is greater than the median mass of group 2.
The median mass of group 1 is less than the median mass of group 2.
e: Box plot показывает median (линия внутри коробки), а не mean.
Median группы 1 ≈ 27, группы 2 ≈ 24 → у группы 1 больше.
Ловушка: про mean по box plot ничего утверждать нельзя.

q:
The histogram summarizes data set A, which represents the number of points per player earned by 50 players of a game. A new player earns 18 points playing the game, and this number of points is added to data set A to create data set B with 51 values. Which of the following must be true?
I. The median number of points per player for data set B is less than the median number of points per player for data set A.
II. The mean number of points per player for data set B is less than the mean number of points per player for data set A.
e: 18 меньше всех значений (все ≥ 30) → mean точно уменьшится.

Median: в наборе A median — среднее 25-го и 26-го значений, оба в столбце 50–60; в B median — 26-е значение из 51 = старое 25-е, тоже в 50–60. Оно может быть равно старому → «must be true» не выполняется.
Ловушка: один маленький выброс сильно тянет mean, но median почти не двигает.

q:
Ages of 20 Students Enrolled in a College Class
Age | Frequency

19 | 5
20 | 4
21 | 2
22 | 1
23 | 1
30 | 1
The table above shows the distribution of ages of the 20 students enrolled in a college class. Which of the following gives the correct order of the mean, median, and mode of the ages?
e: Mode — самое частое: 18. Median — среднее 10-го и 11-го значений: 10-е = 19, 11-е = 19 → 19.
Ловушка: выброс 30 тянет mean вверх, поэтому mean больше median.

q:

The frequency table summarizes the 57 data values in a data set. What is the maximum data value in the data set?
e: Максимум — наибольшее значение с ненулевой частотой.
Ловушка: 11 — это наибольшая частота, а не наибольшее значение.

q:
The results of two independent surveys are shown in the table below.
Men's Height
Group | Sample size | Mean (centimeters) | Standard deviation (centimeters)
A | 2,500 | 186 | 12.5
B | 2,500 | 186 | 19.1
Which statement is true based on the table?
c: The Group A data set was identical to the Group B data set.
Group B contained the tallest participant.
The heights of the men in Group B had a larger spread than the heights of the men in Group A.
The median height of Group B is larger than the median height of Group A.
e: Standard deviation — мера разброса: больше SD → больше разброс.
У B SD 19.1 > 12.5 у A → разброс больше.
Ловушка: одинаковый mean не значит одинаковые данные; про максимум и median SD ничего не говорит.

q:
For data set A, the table summarizes the distribution of the number of deliveries received by an office each day during a period of 11 days.
Deliveries | Days
0 | 2
3 | 2
4 | 2
5 | 2
6 | 1
7 | 1
13 | 1
The data value 13 was recorded in error and is removed from data set A to create data set B, which consists of the remaining 10 data values. Which statement best compares the median of data set A and the median of data set B?
c: The median of data set B is less than the median of data set A.
The median of data set B is greater than the median of data set A.
The median of data set B is equal to the median of data set A.
There is not enough information to compare the medians of the two data sets.
e: Выписываем A по порядку: 0, 0, 3, 3, 4, 4, 5, 5, 6, 7, 13 (11 значений) → median = 6-е = 4.
B без 13: 10 значений → median = среднее 5-го и 6-го = (4 + 4)/2 = 4.
Ловушка: удаление выброса меняет mean, но median здесь не сдвинулась.

q:
15, 14, 18, 17, x
The mean and the median of the five numbers above are equal. Which of the following is NOT a possible value of x?
e: Проверяем каждый вариант: сумма четырёх чисел 64.
x = 11: mean 15, median 15 ✓; x = 16: mean 16, median 16 ✓; x = 21: mean 17, median 17 ✓.

q:
Data set A consists of 10 positive integers less than 60. The list shown gives 9 of the integers from data set A.
43, 45, 44, 43, 38, 39, 40, 46, 40
The mean of these 9 integers is 42. If the mean of data set A is an integer that is greater than 42, what is the value of the largest integer from data set A?
e: Сумма 9 чисел: 42·9 = 378. Десятое число x: (378 + x)/10 — целое больше 42.
Mean = 43 → x = 430 − 378 = 52. Mean = 44 → x = 62, но все числа < 60 → не подходит.
x = 52 — оно же наибольшее в наборе.
Ловушка: проверь ограничение «less than 60», иначе получится 62.

q:
Data Set Q
Value | Frequency
a | 110
b | 30
c | 0
Data Set R
Value | Frequency
a | 0
b | 3
c | 11
Data sets Q and R are summarized in the tables shown, where a, b, and c are positive, consecutive integers and a < b < c. Which statement comparing the means of the data sets is true?
c: The mean of data set R is 2(11)/14 less than the mean of data set Q.
The mean of data set R is 2(11)/14 greater than the mean of data set Q.
The mean of data set Q is 10 times the mean of data set R.
The means of the two data sets are equal.
e: Подставляем b = a + 1, c = a + 2 и считаем оба mean.
Ловушка: можно взять конкретные a = 1, b = 2, c = 3 и посчитать числами.

q:
Value | Data set A frequency | Data set B frequency
30 | 2 | 9
34 | 4 | 7
38 | 5 | 5
42 | 7 | 4
46 | 9 | 2
Data set A and data set B each consist of 27 values. The table shows the frequencies of the values for each data set. Which of the following statements best compares the means of the two data sets?
c: The mean of data set A is greater than the mean of data set B.
The mean of data set A is less than the mean of data set B.
The mean of data set A is equal to the mean of data set B.
There is not enough information to compare the means of the data sets.
e: Считать не обязательно: у A больше частоты у больших значений (42, 46), у B — у малых (30, 34).
Значит mean A больше mean B.
Desmos: mean можно проверить как (30·2 + 34·4 + 38·5 + 42·7 + 46·9)/27 ≈ 40.4 против ≈ 35.6.

q: A data set of 27 different numbers has a mean of 33 and a median of 33. A new data set is created by adding 7 to each number in the original data set that is greater than the median and subtracting 7 from each number in the original data set that is less than the median. Which of the following measures does NOT have the same value in both the original and new data sets?
e: 13 чисел выше медианы получают +7, 13 ниже — −7: сумма не меняется → mean и sum те же. Median (среднее число) не трогали.
Но числа разошлись от центра → разброс вырос → standard deviation увеличилась.
Ловушка: SD измеряет разброс, а не центр.

q: Which of the following lists represents a data set with the smallest standard deviation?
e: Standard deviation меньше там, где числа теснее прижаты к mean (у всех mean = 54).
Ловушка: считать SD не надо — смотри, насколько числа разбросаны.

q: The two box plots show the distribution of number of books read over the summer by the students in two different English classes. What is the positive difference between the ranges of number of books read over the summer for the two classes?
e: Class A: от 0 до 6 → 6. Class B: от 2 до 12 → 10.

q:
International Tourist Arrivals, in millions
Country | 2012 | 2013
France | 83.0 | 84.7
United States | 66.7 | 69.8
Spain | 57.5 | 60.7
China | 57.7 | 55.7
Italy | 46.4 | 47.7
Turkey | 35.7 | 37.8
Germany | 30.4 | 31.5
United Kingdom | 26.3 | 32.2
Russia | 24.7 | 28.4
The table above shows the number of international tourist arrivals, rounded to the nearest tenth of a million, to the top nine tourist destinations in both 2012 and 2013. Based on the information given in the table, how much greater, in millions, was the median number of international tourist arrivals to the top nine tourist destinations in 2013 than the median number in 2012, to the nearest tenth of a million?
e: 9 стран → median — 5-е значение по порядку в каждом столбце.
Ловушка: столбцы надо сортировать отдельно — порядок стран не совпадает с порядком чисел.

q:
The dot plots represent the distributions of values in data sets A and B. Which of the following statements must be true?
I. The median of data set A is equal to the median of data set B.
II. The standard deviation of data set A is equal to the standard deviation of data set B.
e: Оба набора симметричны относительно 13 с одинаковым числом точек → median одинаковая (13).
Но в B точки сильнее разбросаны к краям (10 и 16), в A сгруппированы ближе к центру → SD разные.
Ловушка: одинаковый центр не значит одинаковый разброс.

q:
Weight (pounds) | Frequency
13 | 12
14 | 8
15 | 5
16 | 7
17 | 9
18 | 10
19 | 13
20 | 7
The frequency table summarizes a data set of the weights, rounded to the nearest pound, of 71 tortoises. A weight of 39 pounds is added to the original data set, creating a new data set of the weights, rounded to the nearest pound, of 72 tortoises. Which statement best compares the mean and median of the new data set to the mean and median of the original data set?
c: The mean of the new data set is greater than the mean of the original data set, and the median of the new data set is greater than the median of the original data set.
The mean of the new data set is greater than the mean of the original data set, and the medians of the two data sets are equal.
The mean of the new data set is less than the mean of the original data set, and the median of the new data set is less than the median of the original data set.
The mean of the new data set is less than the mean of the original data set, and the medians of the two data sets are equal.
e: Median исходного (71 значение) — 36-е: накопленные частоты 12, 20, 25, 32, 41 → 36-е = 17. Нового (72) — среднее 36-го и 37-го, оба = 17.
Ловушка: выброс сильно влияет на mean и почти не влияет на median.

q: Data set A has 15 values and is represented by the dot plot shown. Data set B is created by adding 46 to each of the values in data set A. Which of the following correctly compares the medians and the ranges of data sets A and B?
c: The median of data set B is greater than the median of data set A, and the range of data set B is equal to the range of data set A.
The median of data set B is greater than the median of data set A, and the range of data set B is greater than the range of data set A.
The median of data set B is equal to the median of data set A, and the range of data set B is greater than the range of data set A.
The median of data set B is equal to the median of data set A, and the range of data set B is equal to the range of data set A.
e: Прибавление константы ко всем значениям сдвигает центр (median +46), но разброс (range) не меняет.
Ловушка: range = max − min, и +46 сокращается.

q:
The table shown summarizes the number of employees at each of the 17 restaurants in a town.
Number of employees | Number of restaurants
2 to 7 | 2
8 to 13 | 4
14 to 19 | 2
20 to 25 | 7
26 to 31 | 2
Which of the following could be the median number of employees for the restaurants in this town?
e: 17 ресторанов → median — 9-й по порядку. Накопленные: 2, 6, 8, 15 → 9-й попадает в группу 20–25.

q: Two data sets of 23 integers each are summarized in the histograms shown. For each of the histograms, the first interval represents the frequency of integers greater than or equal to 10, but less than 20. The second interval represents the frequency of integers greater than or equal to 20, but less than 30, and so on. What is the smallest possible difference between the mean of data set A and the mean of data set B?
e: Гистограммы одинаковой формы, но A сдвинута на один интервал (10) вправо относительно B.
Чтобы средние были как можно ближе: в A берём минимальные значения интервалов (20, 30, 40, 50), в B — максимальные (19, 29, 39, 49).
Каждое значение A больше соответствующего B ровно на 1 → разница средних 1.

q: Jennifer bought a box of Crunchy Grain cereal. The nutrition facts on the box state that a serving size of the cereal is 3/4 cup and provides 210 calories, 50 of which are calories from fat. In addition, each serving of the cereal provides 180 milligrams of potassium, which is 5% of the daily allowance for adults. If p percent of an adult's daily allowance of potassium is provided by x servings of Crunchy Grain cereal per day, which of the following expresses p in terms of x?
e: Одна порция даёт 5% нормы → x порций дают 5x процентов.
Ловушка: лишние числа (210, 50, 180) — отвлекают; зависимость линейная, не exponential.

q: The expression 0.35x represents the result of decreasing a positive quantity x by what percent?
e: 0.35x — это то, что осталось (35%). Уменьшили на 100% − 35% = 65%.
Ловушка: 35% — остаток, а спрашивают, на сколько уменьшили.

q: A school district is forming a committee to discuss plans for the construction of a new high school. Of those invited to join the committee, 15% are parents of students, 45% are teachers from the current high school, 25% are school and district administrators, and the remaining 6 individuals are students. How many more teachers were invited to join the committee than school and district administrators?
e: Сначала находим общее число: ученики — остаток 100 − 15 − 45 − 25 = 15% = 6 человек → всего 40.

q: In a sample, 80% of the items are faulty. There are 88 faulty items in the sample. How many total items are in the sample?

A square scale drawing has a side length of 55 inches, and 1 inch on the drawing represents an actual distance of 19 miles. A larger version of the same drawing is printed as a square with the side length 65% longer than the side length of the previous drawing. On the larger drawing, which of the following is closest to the actual distance, in miles, represented by 1 inch?
e: Реальная сторона не меняется: 55·19 = 1,045 миль. Новая сторона рисунка: 55·1.65 = 90.75 дюйма.
Ловушка: рисунок больше → 1 дюйм означает меньше миль, значит ответ меньше 19.

q: The positive number a is 2,241% of the sum of the positive numbers b and c, and b is 83% of c. What percent of b is a?
e: Выражаем всё через b: c = b/0.83.
Ловушка: 49.41 — это множитель, в процентах это 4,941%.

q:
Year | Subscriptions sold
2012 | 5,600
2013 | 5,880
The manager of an online news service received the report above on the number of subscriptions sold by the service. The manager estimated that the percent increase from 2012 to 2013 would be double the percent increase from 2013 to 2014. How many subscriptions did the manager expect would be sold in 2014?
e: Ловушка: 2.5% берём от 5,880, а не от 5,600.

q: The line graph shows the total amount of snow, in inches, recorded each year in Washington, DC, from 2003 to 2015. If p% is the percent decrease in the annual snowfall from 2003 to 2007, what is the value of p?
The positive number a is 230% of the number b, and a is 60% of the number c. If c is p% of b, which of the following is closest to the value of p?

An insurance company offers a series of three information sessions. 1,250 people attended the first information session. 72% of the people who attended the first information session attended the second information session, and 36% of the people who attended the first and second information sessions attended the third information session. How many people attended all three information sessions?

During the first month of sales, a company sold 1,300,000 units of a certain type of smartphone. During the same month, 15% of the units sold were returned. If sales and the return rate remain the same for each of the next 5 months, about how many units of this smartphone will be returned to the company during this 6-month period?

The speeds of objects A, B, and C are a meters per second, b meters per second, and c meters per second, respectively. If the speed of object A is 5,900% of the speed of object C and the speed of object C is 0.008% of the speed of object B, which expression represents the value of a + b in terms of c?
e: Переводим проценты в множители: a = 59c; c = 0.00008b.

q: Last year, Cedric had 35 plants in his garden. This year, the number of plants in Cedric's garden is 60% greater than the number of plants in his garden last year. How many plants does Cedric have in his garden this year?
The number a is 190% greater than the number b. The number b is 80% less than 24. What is the value of a?
Which expression represents the result of increasing a positive quantity w by 43%?
e: Ловушка: 0.43w — это сама прибавка, а не результат.

q: The population of City A increased by 7% from 2015 to 2016. If the 2016 population is k times the 2015 population, what is the value of k?
e: Ловушка: 0.07 — это только прирост, а не весь новый размер.

q: Which of the following represents the result of increasing the quantity x by 9%, where x > 0?
e: Ловушка: 0.09x — это только прибавка, x + 9 — прибавка числа, а не процента.

q: The number k is 36% greater than 50. If k is the product of 50 and r, what is the value of r?
In 2008, Zinah earned 14% more than in 2007, and in 2009 Zinah earned 4% more than in 2008. If Zinah earned y times as much in 2009 as in 2007, what is the value of y?
e: Проценты друг за другом перемножаются, а не складываются.
Ловушка: 1.18 (14% + 4%) — неправильно, второй процент берётся от уже увеличенной суммы.

q: The number a is 70% less than the positive number b. The number c is 80% greater than a. The number c is how many times b?
e: Переводим проценты в множители и перемножаем.

q:
Prices of 14 Different Cars
Type of car | Priced at no more than $25,000 | Priced greater than $25,000 | Total
Nonhybrid | 5 | 3 | 8
Hybrid | 2 | 4 | 6
Total | 7 | 7 | 14
The table above shows information about 14 cars listed for sale on an auto dealership's website. If one of the cars listed for sale is selected at random, what is the probability that the car selected will be a hybrid car priced at no more than $25,000?
e: Нужная клетка таблицы: Hybrid и ≤ $25,000 → 2 машины из 14.
Ловушка: знаменатель — все 14 машин, потому что выбирают из всех.

q:

Chocolate | 12 | 4 | 16

The data on the coat color and eye color for 48 Himalayan kittens available for adoption were collected and summarized in the table above. What fraction of the chocolate-colored kittens has deep blue eyes?
e: «Of the chocolate-colored» — знаменатель только шоколадные: 16. Из них с синими глазами 12.
Ловушка: слово «of» после fraction задаёт знаменатель.

q:
Rhesus factor | A | B | AB | O

− | 7 | 2 | 1 | x
Human blood can be classified into four common blood types—A, B, AB, and O. It is also characterized by the presence (+) or absence (−) of the rhesus factor. The table above shows the distribution of blood type and rhesus factor for a group of people. If one of these people who is rhesus negative (−) is chosen at random, the probability that the person has blood type B is 1/9. What is the value of x?
e: Условие «rhesus negative» → знаменатель только строка «−»: 7 + 2 + 1 + x = 10 + x.

q:
| Has bicycle paths | Does not have bicycle paths

The table below shows the number of state parks in a certain state that contain camping facilities and bicycle paths. If one of these state parks is selected at random, what is the probability that it has camping facilities but does not have bicycle paths?
e: Нужная клетка: camping да, bicycle нет → 5. Всего парков: 20 + 5 + 8 + 4 = 37.
Ловушка: без слова «of those with camping» знаменатель — все 37.

q: In a bag, there are 7 red, 4 white, 33 blue, and 33 yellow cubes. If one of these cubes is selected at random, what is the probability of selecting a cube that is neither blue nor yellow?
e: Не синие и не жёлтые — красные и белые: 7 + 4 = 11. Всего: 77.

q: A grove has 6 rows of birch trees and 5 rows of maple trees. Each row of birch trees has 8 trees 20 feet or taller and 6 trees shorter than 20 feet. Each row of maple trees has 9 trees 20 feet or taller and 7 trees shorter than 20 feet. A tree from one of these rows will be selected at random. What is the probability of selecting a maple tree, given that the tree is 20 feet or taller?
e: «Given that ≥ 20 ft» → знаменатель — только высокие деревья.
Высокие берёзы: 6·8 = 48; высокие клёны: 5·9 = 45. Всего высоких 93.
Ловушка: 9/17 — это доля в одной паре рядов без учёта числа рядов.

q:

Group 1 | 12 | 8 | 3
Group 2 | 0 | 17 | 18
Group 3 | 10 | 32 | 0
One of these buttons will be selected at random. What is the probability of selecting a button with a diameter that is less than or equal to 30 millimeters, given that it is not in group 2? (Express your answer as a decimal or fraction, not as a percent.)
e: «Given not in group 2» → знаменатель — группы 1 и 3: 23 + 42 = 65.

q: At a movie theater, there are a total of 350 customers. Each customer is located in either theater A, theater B, or theater C. If one of these customers is selected at random, the probability of selecting a customer who is located in theater A is 0.48, and the probability of selecting a customer who is located in theater B is 0.24. How many customers are located in theater C?

Each vertex of a 14-sided polygon is labeled with one of the 14 letters A through N, with a different letter at each vertex. If one vertex is selected at random, what is the probability that the letter D will be at the selected vertex? (Express your answer as a decimal or fraction, not as a percent.)

On May 10, 2015, there were 83 million Internet subscribers in Nigeria. The major Internet providers were MTN, Globacom, Airtel, Etisalat, and Visafone. By September 30, 2015, the number of Internet subscribers in Nigeria had increased to 97 million. If an Internet subscriber in Nigeria on September 30, 2015, is selected at random, the probability that the person selected was an MTN subscriber is 0.43. There were p million MTN subscribers in Nigeria on September 30, 2015. To the nearest integer, what is the value of p?
e: Probability = часть ÷ всё → часть = probability · всё.

q:
For a science project, Anka recorded whether it rained each weekday and weekend day for 12 weeks. Her results are summarized in the table below.
Weekday and Weekend Day Rain for 12 Weeks
 | Rain | No rain | Total
Number of weekdays | 12 | 48 | 60
Number of weekend days | 8 | 16 | 24

If one of the days on which there was no rain is selected at random, what is the probability the day was a weekend day?
e: Условие «no rain» сужает всё до столбца No rain (64 дня).
Ловушка: 16/84 (4/21) — деление на все дни, а не на дни без дождя.

q:
The table summarizes the distribution of age and assigned group for 90 participants in a study.
 | 0–9 years | 10–19 years | 20+ years | Total
Group A | 7 | 14 | 9 | 30
Group B | 6 | 4 | 20 | 30
Group C | 17 | 12 | 1 | 30
Total | 30 | 30 | 30 | 90
One of these participants will be selected at random. What is the probability of selecting a participant from group A, given that the participant is at least 10 years of age? (Express your answer as a decimal or fraction, not as a percent.)
e: «Given that at least 10» — знаменатель только столбцы 10–19 и 20+.
Всего не младше 10: 30 + 30 = 60. Из них group A: 14 + 9 = 23.
Ловушка: не дели на 90 — условие сужает выборку.

If one of these customer orders is selected at random, what is the probability of selecting an order with thin crust, given the topping is pepperoni? (Express your answer as a decimal or fraction, not as a percent.)
e: «Given pepperoni» — работаем только со строкой Pepperoni.
Ловушка: не дели на все 240 заказов.

q: Set K consists of all the positive integers that are less than or equal to 160, where none of the integers are repeated. If a number is selected at random from set K, what is the probability of selecting a number that is even and less than or equal to 50?
e: Считаем подходящие числа и делим на все 160.

q: At a conference, there are a total of 275 attendees. Each attendee is assigned to either group A, group B, or group C. If one of these attendees is selected at random, the probability of selecting an attendee who is assigned to group A is 0.44 and the probability of selecting an attendee who is assigned to group B is 0.24. How many attendees are assigned to group C?
e: Вероятности трёх групп в сумме дают 1.

q: If 1,200 customers register for new accounts at a social media website every day, what fraction of the first 60,000 new accounts are registered in the first 5 days?

The table above gives the number of United States presidents from 1789 to 2015 whose age at the time they first took office is within the interval listed. Of those presidents who were at least 50 years old when they first took office, what fraction were at least 60 years old?
e: «Of those at least 50» — знаменатель только президенты от 50 лет.
Ловушка: 43 — это все президенты, но условие сужает группу.

q:

 | State sales tax | No state sales tax

q: The International Space Station orbits Earth at an average speed of 4.76 miles per second. What is the space station's average speed in miles per hour?
e: Ловушка: 285.6 — это мили в минуту (×60), нужен ещё один ×60.

q: The population density of Iceland, in people per square kilometer of land area, increased from 2.5 in 1990 to 3.3 in 2014. During this time period, the land area of Iceland was 100,250 square kilometers. By how many people did Iceland's population increase from 1990 to 2014?
e: Ловушка: можно посчитать оба населения и вычесть, но разница плотностей быстрее.

How many fluid ounces are equivalent to 76 quarts? (8 fluid ounces = 1 cup and 4 cups = 1 quart)
If x/y = 4 and 24x/(ny) = 4, what is the value of n?

Pure beeswax has a density of 0.555 ounce per cubic inch. An online company sells pure beeswax at a price of $8.00 per ounce. What is the selling price, in dollars per cubic inch, for pure beeswax purchased from this company?
e: Перемножаем единицы так, чтобы унции сократились: (ounce/in³)·(dollars/ounce) = dollars/in³.

q: The ratio x to y is equivalent to the ratio 9 to 5. If the value of x is 162, what is the value of y?

A sample of oak has a density of 807 kilograms per cubic meter. The sample is in the shape of a cube, where each edge has a length of 0.90 meters. To the nearest whole number, what is the mass, in kilograms, of this sample?
e: Масса = плотность × объём; объём куба 0.9³ = 0.729 м³.
Ловушка: 0.9 надо возвести в куб, а не просто умножить.

q: At a particular track meet, the ratio of coaches to athletes is 1 to 26. If there are x coaches at the track meet, which of the following expressions represents the number of athletes at the track meet?
e: На каждого тренера 26 спортсменов → спортсменов в 26 раз больше: 26x.

q: In a scale model of an office building, a length of 1 inch is equivalent to a length of 17/3 feet in the actual office building. If a length in the actual office building measures x feet, which expression represents the corresponding length, in inches, in the model in terms of x?
e: Делим реальную длину на масштаб: x ÷ (17/3) = 3x/17.
Ловушка: 12 (дюймов в футе) не нужно — масштаб уже даёт дюймы модели через футы здания.

q: On April 18, 1775, Paul Revere set off on his midnight ride from Charlestown to Lexington. If he had ridden straight to Lexington without stopping, he would have traveled 11 miles in 26 minutes. In such a ride, what would the average speed of his horse have been, to the nearest tenth of a mile per hour?
e: Скорость = расстояние / время, время переводим в часы: 26/60 ч.

q: The speed of a vehicle is increasing at a rate of 7.3 meters per second squared. What is this rate, in miles per minute squared, rounded to the nearest tenth? (Use 1 mile = 1,609 meters.)
e: Метры → мили: делим на 1,609. Секунды² → минуты²: умножаем на 60² = 3600.
Ловушка: секунды в квадрате — множитель 60², а не 60.

q: Rectangle A has length 15 and width w. Rectangle B has length 20 and the same length-to-width ratio as rectangle A. What is the width of rectangle B in terms of w?
e: Ловушка: отношение сохраняется умножением, а не прибавлением 5.

q: There is a proportional relationship between p and t. If p = 5,130 when t = 6,840, then what is the value of p when t = 5,472?
An object has a mass of 168 grams and a volume of 24 cubic centimeters. What is the density, in grams per cubic centimeter, of the object?

1 gallon = 128 fl oz, стакан = 16 fl oz.

q: If 4a/b = 6.7 and a/(bn) = 26.8, what is the value of n?
e: Ловушка: 26.8 = 4 · 6.7, так что n = 1/16 можно увидеть сразу: a/b делится на n и становится в 16 раз больше.

q: One of a planet's moons orbits the planet every 252 days. A second moon orbits the planet every 287 days. How many more days does it take the second moon to orbit the planet 29 times than it takes the first moon to orbit the planet 29 times?
e: Разница за один оборот, умноженная на 29.

q: In rectangle PQRS, the length of line segment QS is √2,344 and the length of side PS is 8 more than the length of side RS. What is the length of side QR?
e: QS — диагональ: RS² + PS² = QS², а QR = PS.
a = 30 (−38 не подходит), значит QR = PS = 38.

q: Triangle FGH is similar to triangle JKL, where angle F corresponds to angle J and angles G and K are right angles. If sin(F) = 308/317, what is the value of sin(J)?
e: Соответствующие углы similar треугольников равны → sin тот же.

q: In right triangle RST, the sum of the measures of angle R and angle S is 90 degrees. The value of sin(R) is √15/4. What is the value of cos(S)?
e: Если R + S = 90°, то sin(R) = cos(S).

e: Площадь = ½ · YZ · XY = ½ · 26 · 26 tan 33° = 338 tan 33°.

q: In the figure, AD and BC intersect at point D. If the length of BD is 5 and the tangent of angle CAD is 1.3, what is the length of AD?

What is the perimeter of an equilateral triangle with a height of 39√3?

Acute angle P has a measure of p radians, and acute angle T has a measure of t radians. The function g is defined by g(x) = p(8)^x + 6t. If sin p = cos t, which of the following represents the value g(0) in terms of t?
e: sin p = cos t для острых углов → p + t = π/2 → p = π/2 − t.

q: The score on a trivia game is obtained by subtracting the number of incorrect answers from twice the number of correct answers. If a player answered 40 questions and obtained a score of 50, how many questions did the player answer correctly?
e: Пусть c — верных, тогда неверных 40 − c. Score: 2c − (40 − c) = 50.
Ловушка: неверных не «x», а 40 − c — всего 40 вопросов.

q:
48x − 72y = 30y + 24
ry = 1/6 − 16x
In the given system of equations, r is a constant. If the system has no solution, what is the value of r?
e: Приведём к виду Ax + By = C. Первое: 48x − 102y = 24. Второе: 16x + ry = 1/6.
Нет решений — прямые параллельны: коэффициенты пропорциональны. 48/16 = 3, значит −102/r = 3 → r = −34.
Проверка: правые части 24 и 1/6 — отношение не 3, прямые не совпадают ✓.
Ловушка: сначала перенеси 30y влево, иначе коэффициент при y будет −72, а не −102.
